headline: Thai Credit Guarantee Corporation (TCG) lays out 2027 (2570 B.E.) plan to reduce reliance on government budget, affirms readiness to cooperate with BoT to continue 'SMEs Credit Boost' Phase 2
summary: TCG plans to reduce its dependence on government funding by 2027, using recovered debt money as loan guarantee capacity of about 30,000 million baht. It is ready to cooperate with the Bank of Thailand on SMEs Credit Boost Phase 2.
why: Thai Credit Guarantee Corporation is a state-linked institution that backs bank loans to small and medium enterprises, so its funding model affects SME credit access.
